membershipSource.warning: Postcode records come from a third-party repackage of ONSPD whose provenance has not been verified. Rebuild from the official ONSPD release before relying on this data.

imd.note: Mean English LSOA decile, weighted by source postcode records matched to the current map dataset. 1 most deprived, 10 least. Not a people-weighted deprivation index. England only; mixed-border regions represent their English records only. Published postcode geography can differ from current map geography.

growth.note: Change in median sale price between two complete calendar years. Different properties sell each year: this is not an estimate of individual property appreciation. England and Wales only; at least 20 sales in each year.
